goal: Look up member 1****. Read the member's name and bind it to output 'memberName'. Read the current savings balance and bind it to output 'savingsBalance'. Then open a new savings sub-account with a 500 dollar opening deposit and reach the review screen. Do not click Create Account.

intent: Enter the member ID 1**** to search for the member
expectedEffect: The textbox will be populated with "1****"

intent: Click the Search button to retrieve member 1****'s information
expectedEffect: The member's profile and account information will be displayed

intent: Read the member's name to bind to output 'memberName'
expectedEffect: The member name "J****" will be stored in the memberName output

intent: Read the current savings balance to bind to output 'savingsBalance'
expectedEffect: The savings balance "$****" will be stored in the savingsBalance output

intent: Click on 'Open New Account' to start opening a new savings sub-account
expectedEffect: A form to open a new account will be displayed
The account type dropdown will show 'Savings' as selected

intent: Enter the opening deposit amount of 500 dollars
expectedEffect: The opening deposit field will show '500'

intent: Click 'Continue to Review' to reach the review screen
expectedEffect: The review screen will be displayed showing the details of the new savings account before creation
